local function SurroundString(String, Add)
local Left = ""
local Right = ""

local Remove = false
if Add == "[]" then
    String = string.gsub(String, "%[", "")
    String = string.gsub(String, "%[", "")

    Left = "["
    Right = "]"
elseif Add == "--" then
    Left = "-"
    Right = "-"
    Remove = true
elseif Add == "<>" then
    Left = "<"
    Right = ">"
    Remove = true
end
if Remove then
    String = string.gsub(String, Left, "")
    String = string.gsub(String, Right, "")
end

return Left..String..Right
end
